description: Send another prompt to a delegate that has already finished, keeping everything it read and said. Turns are cumulative: follow_up is refused once maxTurns is used up. The wall-clock limit applies to each run. Memory sessions can continue while retained here; durable sessions can continue after reconnecting while retained on disk. For a live session, use `steer`.

attachments.description: Absolute paths of text files appended to this prompt, as on spawn

prompt.description: The next turn for this delegate

saveTo.description: Absolute file path for this run's final text, as on spawn

name: follow_up
